post.message: Running a warehouse or shop in Miami? A roll-up door that has to be propped open, scrapes on one side, or sits crooked at the bottom is telling you something. A quick daily walk-through can catch a lot of it: watch one full cycle, look for dented guides and loose hardware, and test the sensing edge and photo-eyes. Anything involving springs or the tension wheel is for a trained technician. Our new guide lays out the full commercial roll-up door checklist for business owners and building managers.

review.notes: Independent subagent review: PASS; optional nits applied.
